scope: Agent-defined proxy relevance assumptions, not user judgments. No title targets are inferred from existing ranks.

grade_scale.3: Core requirements supported and requested modifiers strongly supported
grade_scale.2: Core requirements supported; modifiers plausible, mixed, or incompletely described without contradiction
grade_scale.1: Partial relevance: related core but at least one requested core requirement remains unsupported
grade_scale.0: Explicit contradiction of a core/exclusion or clearly incidental relevance
grade_scale.null: Insufficient evidence to distinguish relevance from irrelevance

queries.assumed_intent: Deliberately absurd, surreal, or incoherent entertainment
core: Absurdist or surreal sensibility is central
queries.strong: Sustained absurdist situations, surreal logic, or intentionally nonsensical comedy
queries.acceptable: Substantial eccentric, camp, or surreal entertainment even if narrative remains coherent
queries.incidental_or_wrong: A nonsense word in a description, one silly character, generic family animation, or bad quality alone
queries.ambiguity: Could express dissatisfaction rather than a discovery request; this experiment assumes discovery

queries.assumed_intent: Unresolved creator lookup versus stylistic affinity
queries.strong: Score separately for the two declared readings, never merge them into one presumed intent
queries.acceptable: Conditional on the reading being evaluated
queries.incidental_or_wrong: A reference to the name alone does not establish creator identity or stylistic affinity

core: A work directed by Andrei Tarkovsky
readings.strong: Creator credit verified in supplied evidence
readings.acceptable: A substantial documentary specifically about the creator, with this broader inclusion stated

core: Contemplative, poetic, philosophical cinema with a sustained visual or spiritual sensibility
readings.strong: Several of these stylistic traits are supported by description
readings.acceptable: Clear contemplative or philosophical affinity; exact creator identity not required

queries.ambiguity: No default reading may be called the user's actual intent

queries.assumed_intent: A comforting or upbeat series centered on cooking
core: Cooking or food preparation is a central continuing subject
A show or series
queries.strong: Cooking-focused series with supportive, convivial, low-conflict or clearly uplifting tone
queries.acceptable: Cooking-focused series with plausible enjoyable tone; ordinary competition alone does not make it wrong
queries.incidental_or_wrong: Gardening, home renovation, pottery, generic wholesome shows, or food merely appearing in a dramatic story
queries.ambiguity: Feel-good tolerance for competitive tension is not specified

queries.assumed_intent: Horror in outer-space or off-world conditions with gradual tension
core: Outer-space, spacecraft or off-world setting is material
Horror or sustained fear is central
modifiers: Gradual, atmospheric build rather than continuous action
queries.strong: All core requirements and deliberate dread-building pacing supported
queries.acceptable: Space horror with some patient atmosphere and mixed pacing
queries.incidental_or_wrong: Earthbound horror with no material space setting, generic science fiction, or high-action space adventure without horror
queries.ambiguity: An alien on Earth alone is not enough to establish space as the requested setting

queries.assumed_intent: A suspenseful planned-theft thriller that avoids a relentlessly hopeless tone
core: A heist, robbery operation or planned theft is central
Thriller suspense or tension is material
explicit_exclusions: Relentlessly bleak or hopeless overall tone
queries.strong: Tense central heist with playful, hopeful, resilient or otherwise non-bleak treatment
queries.acceptable: Heist thriller whose tone is mixed but not affirmatively relentlessly bleak
queries.incidental_or_wrong: Generic crime or revenge without a central heist; a strongly supported hopeless treatment violates the explicit exclusion
queries.ambiguity: Violence or a sad event alone does not prove overall bleakness; unknown tone is not a violation

queries.assumed_intent: A story centrally exploring a parent or caregiver's grief following a child's death
core: A child has died
A parent or caregiver's subsequent grief is central
queries.strong: Sustained exploration of bereavement and its emotional or relational aftermath
queries.acceptable: The loss and aftermath are important though shared with another major plot
queries.incidental_or_wrong: Generic sadness, a child grieving a parent, infertility alone, or missing-child rescue without established bereavement
queries.ambiguity: Losing could mean disappearance rather than death; record this alternate reading, but primary proxy grading assumes bereavement

queries.assumed_intent: Unresolved intense angry mood versus title lookup
core: For the conditional mood reading, anger, rage or ferocious intensity is central
queries.strong: Sustained furious energy or anger-driven conflict under the mood reading
queries.acceptable: High-intensity or rage-driven entertainment with clear affinity
queries.incidental_or_wrong: Fast pacing without anger or ferocity is insufficient on its own; a furious word match is not a relevance judgment
queries.ambiguity: Could name a specific title or franchise; do not invent which title. Report mood result conditionally

queries.assumed_intent: Unknown; optional sensitivity analysis assuming the intended word was crazy
queries.strong: No unconditional relevance grade; if crazy is assumed, sustained eccentric or chaotic entertainment
queries.incidental_or_wrong: Do not infer meaning from the existing fingerprint, existing winners, or spelling similarity alone
queries.ambiguity: Could be crazy, crafty, a name or another term; exclude from decisive aggregate

queries.assumed_intent: A melancholy mystery materially involving a lighthouse keeper
core: A lighthouse keeper or keeping a lighthouse is material to the story
A mystery or unexplained situation is central
queries.strong: Keeper, mystery and melancholy are all supported
queries.acceptable: Keeper-centered mystery with plausible subdued or melancholy tone
queries.incidental_or_wrong: A lighthouse briefly used as scenery; a different kind of keeper; melancholy crime unrelated to a lighthouse keeper
queries.ambiguity: No particular famous lighthouse title is assumed

queries.assumed_intent: Science fiction in which cars or road vehicles matter
core: Science-fiction premise or setting
Cars, road vehicles, driving or vehicle pursuit are material
queries.strong: Vehicle-centered science fiction or cars central to the speculative mechanism or conflict
queries.acceptable: Science fiction with a substantial driving or road-vehicle component
queries.incidental_or_wrong: Ordinary cars in a futuristic city, spaceship-only adventures, or realistic racing without a science-fiction premise
queries.ambiguity: No required action intensity, racing format, car count or franchise is specified

queries.assumed_intent: Unresolved literal scene/object clue versus cultural-reference or mood search
core: For literal reading, sunglasses worn or used at night are a meaningful feature
queries.strong: Literal feature explicitly supported, or a separately declared reference reading directly supported
queries.acceptable: Sunglasses are narratively central but nighttime use is uncertain: partial literal evidence only
queries.incidental_or_wrong: Generic stylish nocturnal imagery, sunglasses alone, or a familiar remembered movie without supplied supporting evidence
queries.ambiguity: Song/reference interpretation and literal movie clue are both possible; unknown nighttime use must remain unknown

queries.assumed_intent: Fantasy featuring actual dragons as meaningful creatures
core: Fantasy premise or world
Actual dragons appear materially
queries.strong: Dragons are central or substantial participants in the fantasy story
queries.acceptable: Dragons recur or matter while sharing the fantasy story with other elements
queries.incidental_or_wrong: Dragon in a person's name, a martial-arts metaphor, title-only word matches, or fantasy without supported dragons
queries.ambiguity: Animation, age audience, tone and dragon friendliness are unspecified

queries.assumed_intent: Other entertainment with a repeating-day/time-loop premise, preferably character growth or comedy
core: Repeated lived time or a repeating-day/time-loop narrative is central
modifiers: Comedic, romantic or personal-growth affinity to the named reference
queries.strong: A different work with a central time loop plus comedic or personal-growth affinity
queries.acceptable: A different central time-loop story even in another tone or genre
queries.incidental_or_wrong: Groundhog animal/holiday matches, generic wholesome comedy, or nonlinear storytelling without repeated lived time
queries.reference_title_policy: The original is a useful reference/lookup result, but not a new similar suggestion: grade 1 in the discovery proxy and report its rank separately
queries.ambiguity: User may mean tone more than mechanism; the loop-first reading is an explicit proxy assumption

queries.assumed_intent: Time-travel fiction with intricate temporal causality or structure
core: Time travel, causal time loops or movement between time periods is central
modifiers: Complex paradoxes, timelines, causality or intricate temporal plotting
queries.strong: Central time travel with substantial temporal complexity
queries.acceptable: Central time travel with some causal puzzle or structural intricacy
queries.incidental_or_wrong: A complex ordinary mystery, flashbacks alone, or travel in space without time travel
queries.ambiguity: A simple time-travel comedy may be partially relevant but fails the complexity modifier
